title: The Second Coming of Christ
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The Second Coming of Christ is the future, personal, visible, glorious return of Jesus Christ as Lord, Judge, and King. He will return to gather His people, judge evil, raise the dead, and bring God’s redemptive purpose to completion.
summary: The Second Coming of Christ is the future, personal, visible, glorious return of Jesus Christ as Lord, Judge, and King. He will return to gather His people, judge evil, raise the dead, and bring God’s redemptive purpose to completion.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the risen and reigning Lord who will come again in glory. His return is not a myth, symbol, or mere spiritual idea; it is the promised appearing of the Savior who died, rose, ascended, reigns, and will make all things right.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture teaches that Jesus Christ will come again. The same Lord who ascended will return, not as a suffering servant to bear sin again, but as the glorified King who brings salvation, judgment, resurrection, and restoration to their appointed fulfillment.

The return of Christ is personal and visible. The church is not merely waiting for better circumstances, human progress, or symbolic victory. Believers are waiting for the Lord Himself.

The Second Coming brings both comfort and warning. It comforts believers because suffering, weakness, injustice, persecution, grief, and death will not have the final word. It warns the world because Christ will judge evil and call all people to account.

This doctrine should make believers watchful, faithful, and hopeful. Scripture does not give the return of Christ so the church will become obsessed with speculation, date-setting, fear, or argument.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Christian hope is not grounded in politics, culture, health, money, technology, or human improvement. All earthly stability can be shaken. The return of Christ gives believers a hope that cannot be overthrown.

This doctrine also keeps discipleship awake. If Christ is returning, then holiness matters, mission matters, worship matters, repentance matters, and faithfulness matters.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live ready for the return of Christ. Do not chase fear-driven speculation or become careless because His coming seems delayed. Keep watch through faith, obedience, prayer, holiness, and Gospel witness.
